race.comment: KEN'KER (6) talented gelding who comes back in trip for this. Ploughed through the heavy going with a tough on pace second over 1210m at Port Macquarie with the 63kg. Looks up to this and is worth serious consideration. STORMFIELD (3) last appeared five weeks ago when he sat on the speed from the wide gate to finish a courageous second over 1100m at Bathurst in BM66 class. Now in the Alicia Willick stable and gets weight relief with Dalton's claim. Leading contender. CITY GOLD SPEED (10) has been racing well without winning and stays in the mix after running third in the small field over 1000m at Muswellbrook. Proven in all conditions and must be kept safe. DIFENSIVO (4) struggled to draw a decent gate this time in and today is no different. Drops back in trip and grade after fading to run sixth over 1100m at Wyong. Place best.
